music.notes: Day is one rolled E-flat chord; the key turns it to A-flat major 7 #11 under a pad; the cities ride a light pulse with a felt-piano arpeggio, one chord per bar; the pulse stops for the twelve; the end rings on E-flat add 9 and fades over the last 1.2 s.

sfx.role: the keycap N pressed (switch 1.875 s, grid 24.375 s)
the day dropping away after the press
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a soft low swoop

sfx.role: the lamps coming on in a wave (switch) and the tiles turning (grid)
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: glockenspiel notes, E-flat major pentatonic, MIDI 75-91

sfx.role: a city cut in (one per cut, cycling)
sfx.source: code-original, audio/sfx.py: a warm bulb-on tick

placement: audio/cues.py writes plan.json audio.cues at the action times from the shot code; syncOffset is each file's onset measured with sfx_landmarks.py; mix_audio.py mixes and ducks the music 2-4 dB under each cue.
